Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the positional order of the cuneiform digits when converting from base-60. The first symbol was identified as 6 and the second as 56, but the Orchestrator treated 56 as the higher (left) place and 6 as the unit, effectively reversing the given order. This led to computing 56×60 + 6 = 3366 instead of the correct 6×60 + 56 = 416.
